note: Cutout rig for 03 ALIEN bipeds (enemy #3 sniper alien). Same 4 rigid slots as PaperDollCut (torso/head/arm/leg), alien proportions: lanky, long legs, elongated skull, long bio-rifle. Native ~340px tall -> ~114px in game (allies 104). Template source/template_alien (tools/template_cut.py --alien).

slots.name: torso
slots.note: narrow chitin chest, side view facing right. No arms painted. Thin neck stub hidden under the head. hip joints at y=30 under a short pelvis plate

slots.name: head
slots.note: elongated skull swept back-left, big eye looking right, neck stub at the bottom. pivot = neck base

slots.name: arm
slots.note: BOTH thin arms + long bio sniper rifle as one rigid piece, shoulder cap at the left = pivot, muzzle right

slots.name: leg
slots.note: long thin digitigrade leg, hip (pivot) at the top, two-toed foot pointing right
